The '''molator''' was a creature from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] mythology. It was said to use its magical powers to protect Alderaanian royalty. It had a hoary, almost regal look and walked about on [[Insect/Legends|insect]]-like legs.

Molators were used as [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonsters]].
